items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Al Hubler told me that Sinatra called him up...

ctx.x: Oh, what was his name -- Duke asked Crosby to see if he could make a record out of it, and of course he told him that Jeffries had done such a good job that he was scared of doing any other version; that he could not make it any better than Jeffries', which he did do -- he really did a good job on that.

Yeah, he sure did. Another one, you know -- when Frank Sinatra did the album with Duke, and Frank sang 'I Like the Sunrise' from the 'Liberian Suite'? Al Hubler told me that Sinatra called him up and told him, 'I shouldn't have tried it -- nobody but you could sing it'.
